messages:
maya: @deploybot staging publish blocked: KMS annotation missing for image redwood/api:staging-2026-03-20. deploybot shows quarantine flag. anyone know if this is safe to bypass for cutover?

deploy-bot: [system] publish halted — provenance.kms_key_id annotation missing. quarantine=true. proof required: cosign attestation with key id. see https://internal.builds/docs/kms-annotations

sam: ack. is this the new KMS requirement from last week's rollout? i thought it only applied to private cluster pushes.

cheng: yes, org policy changed. all images pushed to prod/staging must have `provenance.kms_key_id` or they'll be quarantined. release notes updated under /releases/2026-03.

jordan: how bad is the window? we have a db migration scheduled in 30m. can we re-run the publish with the annotation quickly?

maya: trying a retag + cosign attest now. if attestation fails we may need rollback. heads up: buildagent-12 has intermittent access to kms, saw failures earlier.

sam: option B: pin the previous image (sha) in the rollout manifests and proceed with migration, then republish afterwards. that avoids emergency key ops.

cheng: agree. pinning previous digest is safest. anyone object to a quick pin and note in release notes that publish retried post-migration?

jordan: no objection. i'll open a quick PR to pin to sha:sha256:abcdef1234567890 and set rollout to canary 10% for 10m.

maya: thanks. if cosign attestation finishes before migration, we can swap. i'll post status.

deploy-bot: action logged: publish-hold created by maya; reason=kms-missing; ticket=INFR-5421; quarantined_image=redwood/api:staging-2026-03-20

sam: added a comment on INFR-5421 about pin plan + migration window.

maya: update — cosign failed: KMS RPC timeout. proceeding with pin + canary PR. will tag update on the migration ticket and release notes. :warning:

jordan: PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/rollouts/pull/412 ready for review, doing quick approvals.

cheng: approved. after migration, schedule a manual republish and verify attestations w/ cosign: `cosign attest --key k8s://projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/rr/cryptoKeys/cosignKey`

maya: noted, will coordinate with release ops to run the republish in the change window + verify provenance. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot — publish remains quarantined until attestation verified or manual override.
